answer: Bonded vouching: a new agent joins only if an established agent locks a 500-token bond on it, and each voucher can back at most 3 newcomers per epoch, so trust climbs one terrace at a time. A 5-grader audit that catches a sybil slashes the bond, so 100 fakes put 50,000 tokens at risk instead of nothing. Weakness: one attacker-owned agent vouches fakes that later vouch more fakes. Fix: a slash flows like a river up the whole vouch chain, burning 30% of every ancestor's bond, so a self-vouched tree collapses like hollow karst once one fake is caught.
